name: Smartsens Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Smartsens Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and sale of CMOS image sensor chips in China and internationally. It offers legacy, advanced imaging, Internet of Things, starlight, Automotive, global shutter, and smart phone series, and personal computer series products for use in security camera, automotive, smart phone, industrial automation, AI and metaverse. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
